title: Scriptura Dataset Source Registry Entry
description: One candidate or approved corpus source. Normative source: BKB-CORPUS-001 sections 3 and 4, and .clinerules/050-data-licensing.md. INGESTIBLE IS A DERIVED PROPERTY: ingestible may be true only where verification_status is 'verified'. This cross-field invariant is enforced by tools/check_licences.py and src/scriptura/provenance/licensing.py, not by this schema.

edition.description: Exactly which edition, version or release. 'The Greek NT' is not a dataset.

rights_holder.description: Who owns the rights, as stated by the rights holder. Never inferred.

availability.description: Verified availability. Never assumed. 'unknown' means availability was not verified.

licence.description: The licence exactly as written, including version. null means no licence was established.

licence_url.description: The URL actually consulted. Must be a primary source for verification_status 'verified'.

retrieved_at.description: When the licence was actually read. ISO 8601 date.

evidence_kind.description: primary = the rights holder's own statement. secondary = an aggregator, catalogue or mirror. A secondary source never establishes rights.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quotation of the licence statement actually found.

licence_cleared.description: True only where verification_status is 'verified' AND the licence was confirmed against a primary source. Records that licence research is complete. This is NOT permission to ingest: ingestion additionally requires an open milestone gate and per-dataset human authorisation (BKB-CORPUS-001 G9, G10).

ingestible.description: True only where licence_cleared is true AND the milestone ingestion gate is open AND a human has authorised ingestion of this specific dataset. At M0 the gate is CLOSED, so ingestible is false for every entry. Enforced by tools/check_licences.py and src/scriptura/provenance/licensing.py.

attribution_text.description: The verbatim attribution string required by the licence. Never paraphrased.

licensing_model.description: single = one licence for the whole source. per_item = each item licensed separately, so an aggregator licence establishes nothing. layered = the underlying text and the added annotation carry different licences. unknown = not established.

citation.description: Preferred citation, copied from the source. Never constructed.

notes.description: Mandatory. Records what was verified, what was not, and any jurisdictional or composite-licensing caveat.

verification_required.description: What must be verified before this source may become ingestible.
